title: Tavern 0.6.170: normalize shaker editor arithmetic
native_evidence_scope: Pinned official conversion/parser/validator evidence for a single arithmetic spelling change. Actual recovered native warning-removal observation remains pending; no full Java/client parity claim.
public_notes_inline:
Normalize one negative offhand shaker coefficient into explicit subtraction for editor compatibility, preserving its numerical values and other motion/gameplay fields. Pair this source release with World Liquor 0.1.148 and the exact Grilling 2.8.149 source/lock.

Known family issue: World Liquor Treasure Guide's mob bonus can copy unrelated newly dropped items; overlapping death callbacks can multiply bonus drops. W148 retains this behavior without a fix. It was reproduced against W148 source in an isolated mocked scheduler, not a native server.

The stable release uses source/editor, strict CI and exact package evidence; it does not claim complete Java parity. Additional real-client, install/upgrade/restart/rollback, saved-world and soak acceptance remain unverified and are not gates for this publication. Existing strict CI, including its native-persistence checks, remains required. Client acceptance, production readiness and live deployment remain false. Earlier runtime evidence is not reassigned to this family.
